summary: SHIP handoff for ZF-1 is ready for a person. README.md change is 14 lines: a Getting Started section before Overview and one TOC entry. Verification was by reading and grep only; the end-to-end run (AC4-AC6) was not performed because MySQL and MongoDB are not available here. Two things a reviewer must decide: (1) R8 is not met because the cp command in step 2 is not in the README and was not run (the executor and verifier both said it was); (2) the branch also contains docs/specs/ZF-1.md and .zerovity/out pipeline files, which R9/AC9 does not allow. The verifier's three low findings (clone command, config values, database creation) are still open. Recommendation is revise, not accept, until (1) is fixed or accepted.

findings.text: R8 not met: the cp command for backend/config.properties is not stated in the README and was not run. The executor and verifier evidence wrongly said every command was already in the README.
Step 1 'Clone the repository and open it' has no command (verifier finding, open).
Step 2 names MYSQL_* and MONGO_URI but gives no values (verifier finding, open).
Step 3 says to create the database but gives no command (verifier finding, open).
R9/AC9 scope: branch diff vs main also includes docs/specs/ZF-1.md and .zerovity/out pipeline files. Only README.md is product change.
